items.ownerDecision: ST6-R (a) asks the restrained specialist (emotional depth 85, composure 75, focus 75, the other nine at 40.56 to keep 600) to beat the even actor (every ability 50) playing the better-suited side, against the grain, on a quarter of 44 materials. Measured at that budget it does on 3. The cause, measured: where restraint suits, with both playing restrained, it's ahead of the even actor on only 13 of 50 (ST6R.diagnostics), because a whole reads a little of every ability its dimensions concern and a quarter of it is the weakest dimension, which for this profile is connection and responsiveness (listening, presence, adaptability at 40.56): one strength doesn't erase an unrelated weakness, which H4-R (c) and the owner's H4 requirement ask. Restraint's own draws add 0.33 to 0.91 to its lift (mean 0.63). Considered, each measured in-process and none adopted for want of a source: the weakest-dimension term removed (11 of 42, meets (a): contrary to the owner's H4 requirement and to H2's history); restraint's control doubled (5 of 42); focus or composure drawn on connection (6 to 7 of 42); focus on connection and responsiveness (13 of 42). The criterion's threshold was set beside ST6′'s 26 of 42, which compared a 645.6 specialist with a 600 even actor; at 645.6 ST6-R is met in full. Other profiles, measured in-process for this decision: the single emotional-depth specialist at 600 (85, the other eleven at 46.82) wins 2 of 44; the criteria's profile with its nine at the even actor's 50 (685) wins 44 of 44 and leaves no limit, so no fair-budget profile meets (a) and an over-budget one erases (d). Options: (1) keep the judge and accept ST6-R (a), (c) and (e) as measured, with their cause: the restrained specialist's craft pays on its own side ((b), restraint's draws 0.33 to 0.91 of its lift) and against slight grain (3 wins), and its limits are kept ((d), 39 of 44); (2) authorize, with a stated basis, a change to the weakest-dimension term, the one change measured to reach (a) (11 of 42 with it removed), measured first against H2, H4-R (c) and every interpretation and stage criterion; (3) restate (a)'s comparison or threshold. Recommended: (1), with the threshold reconsidered by the owner, since it was set beside a figure measured on unequal budgets; the brief rules out an unexplained restraint bonus, and the evidence found no reading of restraint, sourced, that carries a specialist weaker than the even actor on its own side. (g): (b) can't catch a restraint that draws nothing, since expansive's draws read this specialist's weakest abilities, so its lift playing expansive is lower whatever restraint does; a (b) comparing the restrained lift with restraint's draws against without them would, and tests/decisions-judge.test.ts holds that comparison (0.3 or more on every material).

items.ownerDecision: Memory's and composure's own work is all briefs (119 and 92 pieces): no other kind of work in the catalog varies what memory or composure is about. Memory reads a brief's length (DEMAND_EFFECT.text) and not a class scene's, though the catalog holds each scene's length (Scene.size); read at a brief's sizes, memory would be best on 42 of 65 scenes and H2 would fail (measured in-process, not adopted). A night reads every line of a part at one weight; the stamina area's running times and participation would give a night's text its length. Composure reads what rides on a piece (DEMAND_EFFECT.stakes), which is a brief's 0 to 3 and 1 for every scene and play by design. Options: (1) once the running times are integrated, read a night's and a casting's text by the part's share of the running time (memory's second kind), measured against H2 and every criterion; (2) read what rides on a performance outside briefs (a Rep night, an understudy sent on, the showcase), a new rule for composure, the owner's to authorize; (3) accept memory's and composure's roles as briefs and the night's consistency, and H4-R (a) as measured. Recommended: (1) for memory after the integration, and (2) for composure only on the owner's word.
